template.description: Sent when admin updates a tech account
template.subject: Account Updated
template.email: Dear $tech_details[greeting]<%line%> <%line%> Your account has been updated by an admin.<%line%> <%line%> The following changes have been made:<%line%> <%line%> <%if $username_changed%> - Your username has been changed to : $tech_details[username]<%line%><%endif%> <%if $password_changed%> - Your password has been changed to : $tech_details[password]<%line%><%endif%> <%if $email_changed%> - Your email has been changed to : $tech_details[email]<%line%><%endif%>
